configurations.name: dev
runtimeArgs: node24=$(ls -d $HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); export PATH="${node24:+$node24:}$PATH"; exec pnpm dev --port "${PORT:-5173}" --strictPort

configurations.name: showcase
runtimeArgs: node24=$(ls -d $HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); export PATH="${node24:+$node24:}$PATH"; exec pnpm -C showcase dev --port 5199
